provenance.instrument: West Norriton Township Zoning Ordinance (Chapter 27 Zoning, Ord. No. 524 of 1991 restating the 1952 ordinance, as amended), as published on eCode360
provenance.status_detail: eCode360 WE2500: 'Includes legislation through 04-14-2026'. The latest amendment seen in the sections read is Ord. No. 2025-781 (4-14-2026). The New Laws page lists no uncodified ordinance.
provenance.code_current_through_note: eCode360 table of contents: 'Includes legislation through 04-14-2026'. New Laws: 'There are currently no known new laws for this Code'.
provenance.code_caution: Attachment 1 (Appendices, the Main Street Commercial streetscape cross-sections) is a PDF and was not opened. Chapter 17 (Planned Residential Development) is a separate chapter and was not read. The Main Street Commercial District (Part 13C, Ord. No. 2023-763) is not in the 27-201 list of district classes, so its map code is not known here (MSC in this file). The code writes the Retirement Residential district as 'R-R' in Part 13B and 27-1001Q(3). This file uses RR. The State Institution Overlay (27-304 to 27-308, Ord. No. 2024-769) is mapped on Exhibit A to that ordinance, which was not seen, so which R-A lots it covers is not known here
checks: In R-A one separate living area with cooking facilities may be provided in a single-family detached dwelling for no more than two persons related to the principal occupant by blood, marriage or adoption. It is registered with the Zoning Officer and a recorded written agreement says the cooking facilities will be removed when those relatives no longer use it (27-301 subsections 6B and 9)

R-1, R-2, R-3, B-P, C and L-C permit the uses permitted in R-A (R-3, B-P, C and L-C without the R-A special exception and farm uses), and I permits the uses permitted in C, so the living area reaches a single-family detached dwelling in those districts too (27-401A, 27-501, 27-602(1), 27-701(1), 27-801(1), 27-901(1), 27-1101A). The rule is written only in R-A, so confirm with the zoning officer
Detached private garages and storage structures 'shall not be used or converted to be used as a dwelling' (27-301 subsection 6A). A unit in a separate new building is not named

The code sets no size cap for the living area and does not define a dwelling unit. District lot areas are set 'per family' (for example 17,000 sq ft per family in R-2, 27-502), and parking is two spaces per dwelling unit (27-1410A). Whether the living area counts as a second family or dwelling unit for these rules is not settled: ask

Conversion of a dwelling by special exception was repealed: 'authority to authorize conversion of dwellings by special exception is rescinded' (27-1404, Ord. No. 09-638). Two-family buildings, twins and duplexes are permitted only in R-3, a district laid out on tracts of at least 10 acres (27-602, 27-603)

Lots created by a new subdivision without public sewer need at least 40,000 sq ft per dwelling unit (150 ft wide) without public water, and 20,000 sq ft (100 ft) with public water (27-1415). The tool cannot apply this to existing lots

In the Revitalization and Traffic Management Overlay any improvement, land development or alteration of an existing building needs conditional use approval from the Board of Commissioners (27-13B03). Yards there are at least 10 ft, and side and rear yards 30 ft next to an existing residential district (27-13B04(11)(B))
In C and L-C one building may hold a residence and a commercial use together by special exception (27-801(15), 27-901(12)). That is not a second dwelling unit

State Institution Overlay (SI) on part of R-A, between the Norristown Farm Park, Norristown Borough and West Sterigere Street (27-305, Ord. No. 2024-769). It is 'a superseding district' whose uses are hospital, mental health, practitioner offices, shelter, emergency response, state offices and social services (27-307), and a new building needing land development there needs conditional use approval (27-306). 27-305.1A also calls its rules 'additional and supplemental to the underlying district provisions and uses', so whether the R-A house and its living area still apply there is not settled: ask

In LC&I a unified development by conditional use may include 'Any use permitted in the Commercial Districts by right or special exception' (27-1001Q(2)), and C takes the R-A uses. So a house, and with it the living area, may reach LC&I inside an approved unified development. Outside one LC&I permits no house

R-A accessory buildings: one private garage no larger than the house's first floor and at most 14 ft at the peak, and one storage structure of at most 250 sq ft and 10 ft at the peak (27-301 subsection 7A). A detached garage or storage structure may stand in a required side or rear yard if it is at least 4 ft from every lot line and at least 10 ft farther back from the street than the rear of the house (27-1406)

R-3 single-family lots: buildings at least 30 ft from public streets in the tract, 50 ft from a public street next to the tract and 35 ft from the development boundary, 20 ft between buildings, at most 4 dwelling units per gross acre (27-603). Whether the living area counts toward that density is not settled
provenance.notes: Zoning office: West Norriton Township Zoning Officer. The eCode360 code WE2500 is West Norriton Township, Montgomery County (27-705 and 27-1204 name the Recorder of Deeds of Montgomery County, 27-305 names Montgomery County, and the 27-202 map amendments list Montgomery County parcel numbers). Read in a browser on eCode360, one page at a time, on 2026-11-15. Search with scope all (code and New Laws) for accessory apartment, accessory dwelling, in-law, ECHO, elder cottage, granny, family dwelling, relative, housekeeping unit, caretaker, guest house, tenant house, living quarters, sleeping quarters, immediate family, watchman, separate living, cooking facilities, farm employee, domestic servants and unit for care, then for two-family, duplex, conversion, converted, age-restricted, age-qualified, mobile home, guest, second dwelling, additional dwelling, more than one principal, principal building and effective date. The first search found 27-301 (separate living area, tenant house) and the family, group home and apartment house definitions. Rechecked on screen in the fix round: 27-301 to 27-308 (the State Institution Overlay), 27-603, 27-1001Q, 27-1406 and 27-13B04(11). Read in full: Part 2 (27-201 to 27-204), Parts 3 to 13C (every district: R-A, R-1, R-2, R-3, B-P, C, L-C, LC&I, I, RE, A, RR, the Revitalization and Traffic Management Overlay and Main Street Commercial), Part 14 (27-1401 to 27-1422), Part 18 (27-1801 to 27-1808) and Part 20 (27-2001 to 27-2004). Not read: Parts 15 to 17, 19 and 21 to 25, Chapter 17 and the PDF attachment. The New Laws page lists no ordinance. The Disposition List was not opened

term.value: separate living area, including cooking facilities (for relatives)
term.note: The code has no accessory dwelling unit term. 'One separate living area, including cooking facilities, may be provided for no more than two persons related to the principal occupant of the single-family detached dwelling by blood, marriage or adoption, provided that said use is registered with the Zoning Officer, subject to a written agreement to be recorded, to remove said cooking facilities when no longer utilized by said persons related to the principal occupant as aforesaid.'

status.note: A separate living area with its own cooking facilities, for at most two persons related to the principal occupant, inside a single-family detached dwelling, registered with the Zoning Officer. The rule is an accessory use to a dwelling in R-A and reaches the districts that permit the R-A uses

scope_by_use.note: R-A lists the single-family detached dwelling and the living area. R-1 and R-2 permit any use permitted in R-A. R-3, B-P, C and L-C permit any R-A use except its special exception and farm uses. I permits any use permitted in C. RE, A (apartment houses), RR (retirement communities) and Main Street Commercial (dwellings only above a first-floor shop or office) permit no single-family detached dwelling. LC&I permits no single-family detached dwelling outside a unified development: its own list has watchman and caretaker quarters only, but a unified development by conditional use may include any use permitted in the Commercial Districts (27-1001Q(2)), and C takes the R-A uses

status_outside.note: These districts permit no single-family detached dwelling, so the living area does not reach them. In LC&I that holds outside a unified development only (27-1001Q(2))

status_by_form.note: 27-301 subsection 6A: 'One private detached garage and one detached storage structure in accordance with Subsection 7A (below). Private detached garages and storage structures shall not be used or converted to be used as a dwelling.' A private garage may also be 'part of a main building' (27-2001), and space in an attached garage made part of the house reads as the internal form

path.note: No hearing. The use is registered with the Zoning Officer (subsection 6B) or the Building Inspector (subsection 9), with a recorded written agreement to remove the cooking facilities when the relatives no longer use them

fallback_path.note: 'The Zoning Hearing Board shall hear requests for variances where it is alleged that the provisions of this chapter inflict unnecessary hardship upon the applicant' (MPC 910.2 findings). No section read bars a use variance. The 'same general character' clauses (27-801(13), 27-901(9), 27-1001O, 27-1101D) reach only uses like the commercial and industrial uses listed there

value.name: Two-family building, twin or duplex in an R-3 development
value.conditions: R-3 permits single-family detached buildings and 'Two-family buildings, twin and duplex dwellings'. The district is laid out on a tract of at least 10 acres (the Commissioners may make exceptions, no plot under one acre). Two-family density at most 5 dwelling units per gross acre. Two-family lots 2,700 sq ft per dwelling unit, 35 ft wide per unit, 15 ft side yards on each side of the building, building coverage 40%, front or rear yard 30 ft, buildings 50 ft from a public street next to the tract, 35 ft from the development boundary, 20 ft between buildings, 35 ft tall. Two parking spaces per dwelling unit
value.note: Not an ADU listing. A building type in a tract development, not a unit added to one house. 27-601 defines a two-family building as 'A residential building containing two dwelling units, which is not attached to any other structure'. Conversion of a dwelling by special exception was repealed (27-1404, Ord. No. 09-638)

value.name: Tenant house or quarters for farm or estate employees
value.conditions: An accessory use in R-A: 'Tenant house or dwelling quarters for tenant farmers or employees of a farm or estate, provided that if a building containing such dwelling quarters is located so that it can be easily subdivided and sold separately from the main dwelling, it shall conform to all area, height and general regulations of the district applying to main buildings.' Farm use needs a lot of at least 10 acres (27-301(2))

requires.condition: The occupants are tenant farmers or employees of the farm or estate

disputed_districts.note: These districts take the R-A uses but bar farm use (R-2) or the R-A special exception and farm uses (the rest). Whether quarters for an estate's employees still reach them is not settled

value.note: Not an ADU listing. Quarters for the employees of a farm or estate, not a unit for a household of the owner's choosing

value.name: Watchman or caretaker quarters (LC&I)
value.conditions: 'Dwelling quarters in connection with any permitted establishment for watchman and caretaker employed upon the premises.' Front yard 50 ft, side yards 25 ft each, rear 25 ft, no building within 200 ft of a residence district, 35 ft tall

requires.condition: The lot holds a permitted establishment and the occupant is its watchman or caretaker

value.note: Not an ADU listing. Quarters for an employee of a business, not a second unit for a house

value.name: Multiplex or townhouse building by conditional use
value.conditions: A multiplex building holds three to eight single-family attached dwellings (27-601). R-A: by conditional use, following the R-3 standards of 27-603 to 27-608 (R-3 tract of 10 acres, 1,800 sq ft per unit, 7 units per gross acre). R-3: by conditional use. B-P: townhouses by conditional use on a 20-acre tract at up to 12 units per gross acre (27-710). Board of Commissioners hearing (27-1708)

disputed_districts.note: R-1 and R-2 permit any use permitted in R-A, and R-A lists multiplex buildings by conditional use (27-301(10), Ord. No. 2020-739). Whether that carries the conditional use to R-1 and R-2 is not settled

value.note: Not an ADU listing. Three or more attached units in a tract development, never one unit added to a house

value.name: Retirement residential community (RR)
value.conditions: Retirement residential units, personal care units and nursing care units forming a single operating unit. The district covers at least 20 acres. Building coverage 12% of the tract, 100 ft setbacks and buffer, at most 8 dwelling units per gross acre, each unit at most 1,200 sq ft and two persons (at least one 55 or older), 35 ft or three stories, two parking spaces per independent unit, public water and sewer, 50% open space
value.note: Not an ADU listing. An age-restricted development on its own district, not a unit added to a house

zoning_districts.note: R-A by its own text. The others take the R-A uses by reference (I through C)

building_types.note: 'When accessory to a single-family detached dwelling only'

value.condition: The separate living area is for no more than two persons related to the principal occupant of the single-family detached dwelling by blood, marriage or adoption.
The use is registered with the Zoning Officer (or Building Inspector), subject to a recorded written agreement to remove the cooking facilities when the related persons no longer use the living area.

Lots in an R-2 cluster subdivision (conditional use, 5 contiguous acres, public water and sewer, 40% open space) take the cluster figures: lot 10,000 sq ft, 65 ft wide, front 30 ft, side 10 ft each, rear 25 ft, building coverage 30%, accessory buildings in the rear yard only and at most 20 ft and one story. Each cluster lot holds one single-family detached dwelling and permitted accessory uses.

In the Revitalization and Traffic Management Overlay any improvement of property, land development or alteration of an existing building needs conditional use approval from the Board of Commissioners. Front, side and rear yards are at least 10 ft, and side and rear yards at least 30 ft next to an existing residential zoning district. Three stories and 35 ft, and 15% green area.

The State Institution Overlay is 'a superseding district' in which a lot may be used for hospital, mental health, medical and social services offices, shelter, emergency response and Commonwealth uses. A new building needing land development there needs conditional use approval. No dwelling is listed.

disputed_by.note: 'The provisions and requirements of the West Norriton Township State Institution Overlay District ("SI District") shall be additional and supplemental to the underlying district provisions and uses', so the R-A house and its living area may still apply

districts_read_no_listing.note: LC&I lists watchman and caretaker quarters, and apartment houses and any Commercial District use only in a unified development by conditional use (27-1001Q). RE lists recreation uses and restaurants. A lists apartment house buildings. RR lists retirement communities. Main Street Commercial lists dwellings only in a mixed use building above a first-floor retail or office use

types_allowed.note: The living area is 'accessory to a single-family detached dwelling' and the code does not say where it sits. A part of the house, or an addition that becomes part of it, is read as allowed

types_not_addressed.note: A separate new building for the living area is not named. The detached accessory buildings named for a dwelling are one private garage and one storage structure, which may not be used as a dwelling

value.over_garage: A unit over a detached garage

max_sqft.note: No size cap for the living area

internal_uses_district_height.note: 35 ft in every district that permits a house (50 ft for R-A buildings in the 0.2% chance floodplain)

front_yard_barred.note: 'Other detached structures shall not be located within the required front yard or forward of the front facade of an existing dwelling.' Detached garages may not stand in any required front yard

value.where: that is the private detached garage (one per lot)
value.note: No larger than the first floor of the house, a peaked roof, at most 14 ft at the peak. Written in R-A

value.where: that is the detached storage structure (one per lot)
value.note: At most 250 sq ft, a peaked roof, at most 10 ft at the peak, not permanently attached to the ground. Written in R-A

value.where: that is a garage or storage structure in a required side or rear yard
value.note: At least 4 ft from every property line and at least 10 ft farther back from the street line than the rearmost part of the house

accessory_rules_where.note: Garages and storage structures may not be used as a dwelling (27-301 subsection 6A), so these reach no unit today

value.note: 'a total area no greater than the square footage of the first floor of the dwelling to which it is accessory'

owner_occupancy.note: No owner rule. The persons must be related to the principal occupant

occupancy.value: No more than two persons related to the principal occupant of the house by blood, marriage or adoption.

spaces_required.note: No parking rule for the living area

reading.value: 'Two improved all-weather parking spaces for each dwelling unit' (27-1410A). The code does not define a dwelling unit, so whether the living area needs two more spaces (four in all) or none beyond the house's two is not settled.

min_lot_sqft.note: 'A lot area of not less than 40,000 square feet per family'. Frontage 200 ft. Whether the living area counts as a second family is not settled

setback_front_ft.note: 25 ft on the long side of a corner lot

setback_side_ft.note: Two side yards, neither less than 20 ft

principal_max_height_ft.note: 50 ft for buildings in the 0.2% chance floodplain (27-303)

max_building_coverage.note: 'Building Area'. 27-2001 defines BUILDING AREA as 'The aggregate of the maximum horizontal cross-section areas ... of all buildings on a lot', so this is building cover. The code sets no impervious cover figure for houses

min_lot_sqft.note: 'A lot area of not less than 30,000 square feet per family'. Frontage 150 ft

setback_front_ft.note: 20 ft on the long side of a corner lot

setback_side_ft.note: For every dwelling two side yards together at least 30 ft, neither under 12 ft

max_building_coverage.note: 'Building Area'. 27-2001 defines BUILDING AREA as 'The aggregate of the maximum horizontal cross-section areas ... of all buildings on a lot', so this is building cover. The code sets no impervious cover figure for houses

min_lot_sqft.note: 'A lot area of not less than 17,000 square feet per family'. Width at the building line 85 ft

setback_front_ft.note: 15 ft on the long side of a corner lot. May be reduced to the average alignment of existing buildings within 100 ft (27-1413)

setback_side_ft.note: For every dwelling two side yards together at least 25 ft, neither under 10 ft

max_building_coverage.note: 'Building Area'. 27-2001 defines BUILDING AREA as 'The aggregate of the maximum horizontal cross-section areas ... of all buildings on a lot', so this is building cover. The code sets no impervious cover figure for houses

min_lot_sqft.note: Single-family lot in an R-3 development on a tract of at least 10 acres, 60 ft wide at the building line. Density at most four dwelling units per gross acre for single-family detached dwellings (27-603(2)). The table gives no front or rear yard for single-family lots ('Not applicable'). Buildings stand 30 ft from public streets in the tract, 50 ft from a public street next to the tract, 35 ft from the development boundary and 20 ft from other buildings

max_building_coverage.note: 'Building Area'. 27-2001 defines BUILDING AREA as 'The aggregate of the maximum horizontal cross-section areas ... of all buildings on a lot', so this is building cover. The code sets no impervious cover figure for houses

setback_front_ft.note: The 27-603(3) table gives single-family lots no front or rear yard ('Not applicable'). 27-603(4): 'No building shall be less than 30 feet from any public street within the tract', 50 ft from a public street adjacent to the tract and 35 ft from the development boundary lines. 30 ft is read as the front yard on a street inside the development

min_lot_sqft.note: 'The area, frontage and height regulations provided for in R-A Residence Districts shall apply.' 40,000 sq ft per family, frontage 200 ft

setback_front_ft.note: From 27-302 (R-A area regulations), which also holds the building area and yards. Read as carried over with the area regulations

setback_side_ft.note: From 27-302 (R-A), read as carried over with the area regulations

max_building_coverage.note: 'Building Area'. 27-2001 defines BUILDING AREA as 'The aggregate of the maximum horizontal cross-section areas ... of all buildings on a lot', so this is building cover. The code sets no impervious cover figure for houses

min_lot_sqft.note: 'A lot area of not less than 17,000 square feet per family'. A lot used only for dwellings is 85 ft wide

setback_front_ft.note: 10 ft on the long side of a corner lot. May be reduced to the average alignment of existing buildings within 100 ft (27-1413)

setback_side_ft.note: For a building used only as a residence the R-2 side yards apply: together at least 25 ft, neither under 10 ft

max_building_coverage.note: Building area for a building used in whole or in part as a residence (70% otherwise). 27-2001 defines BUILDING AREA as the aggregate horizontal area of all buildings on a lot, so this is building cover

min_lot_sqft.note: 'A lot area of not less than 17,000 square feet per family'. A lot used only for dwellings is 85 ft wide. A 40 ft buffer beside a residential area applies to limited commercial areas

setback_front_ft.note: 20 ft on the long side of a corner lot. May be reduced to the average alignment of existing buildings within 100 ft

setback_side_ft.note: For a building used only as a residence the R-2 side yards apply: together at least 25 ft, neither under 10 ft

max_building_coverage.note: Building area for a building used in whole or in part as a residence (70% otherwise). 27-2001 defines BUILDING AREA as the aggregate horizontal area of all buildings on a lot, so this is building cover

min_lot_sqft.note: 'The area and height regulations prescribed for Commercial Districts, §§ 27-802 and 27-803, shall apply in Industrial Districts.' A house is permitted in I only through 27-1101A (any use permitted in C)

setback_front_ft.note: From 27-802 (C). May be reduced to the average alignment of existing buildings within 100 ft (27-1413)

setback_side_ft.note: From 27-802 (C): the R-2 side yards for a building used only as a residence

max_building_coverage.note: From 27-802 (C): building area for a building used in whole or in part as a residence. Building cover (27-2001)
